en.text:
Melee Hits grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge. (Each damage instance is counted separately)

Having active Armor Charges grants Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants. Receiving a Melee Attack consumes all Armor Charges and emits a <arc/>Jolting <arc/>Arc Burst in a ? meter radius.

Benefits with 1|2|…|6 Armor Charges:
• <arc/>Arc Burst Damage: 90|130|170|200|225|245
• Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants: 23.3% | 46.7% | 70% | 73.3% | 76.7% | 80%
